name: state-machine-mcp-driver
description: Node.js service to handle state machines via MCP protocol

scripts.example:multi: cross-env OLLAMA_MODEL=gpt-oss:20b MCP_QUIET=false npx tsx examples/multi-ui-launcher.ts examples/configs/x-plus-1-multi-ui.json
scripts.example2:app: cross-env OLLAMA_MODEL=gpt-oss:20b MCP_QUIET=false npx tsx examples/xplus1-app/xplus1-app.ts examples/xplus1-app/xplus1-config.json
scripts.example_app: cross-env OLLAMA_MODEL=gpt-oss:20b MCP_USE_NATIVE_PROTOCOL=true npm run launcher:x-plus-1
scripts.multi:demo: cross-env OLLAMA_MODEL=gpt-oss:20b MCP_USE_NATIVE_PROTOCOL=false MCP_QUIET=false npx tsx examples/multi-ui-launcher.ts examples/configs/x-plus-1-multi-ui.json
scripts.multi:web-only: cross-env OLLAMA_MODEL=gpt-oss:20b MCP_USE_NATIVE_PROTOCOL=false MCP_QUIET=false npx tsx examples/multi-ui-launcher.ts examples/configs/x-plus-1-web-only.json
scripts.multi:console: cross-env OLLAMA_MODEL=gpt-oss:20b MCP_USE_NATIVE_PROTOCOL=true MCP_QUIET=true npm run launcher:x-plus-1
scripts.app:quiet: cross-env OLLAMA_MODEL=gpt-oss:20b MCP_USE_NATIVE_PROTOCOL=true MCP_QUIET=true npm run launcher:x-plus-1
scripts.app:verbose: cross-env OLLAMA_MODEL=gpt-oss:20b MCP_USE_NATIVE_PROTOCOL=true MCP_VERBOSE=true LOG_LEVEL=debug npm run launcher:x-plus-1
scripts.app:normal: cross-env OLLAMA_MODEL=gpt-oss:20b MCP_USE_NATIVE_PROTOCOL=true MCP_QUIET=false MCP_VERBOSE=false npm run launcher:x-plus-1
scripts.threejs:install: npm install threejs-gamification-ui && npm run threejs:setup
